title: Saudi Arabia Halts Energy Sites as Houthis Claim New Attacks
text:
Becca Wasser, adjunct senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security, joins Bloomberg to discuss the latest on the Iran War, control over the Strait of Hormuz, and the current state of U.S. stockpiles of air defense interceptors and long-range standoff munitions.
Watch the full episode on Bloomberg.
